verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own docs say users can click "Add custom integration" and point the AI Assistant at any MCP server, including one they build themselves. The pricing page confirms MCP as a supported way to connect the AI to apps, so the product directly acts as an MCP client. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of custom MCP servers working, and documentation of setup details such as supported transports, authentication, and per-tool permissions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: You can connect virtually any application through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Just click "Add custom integration" and point to an MCP server of your choice — or even create your own.
Connect the AI with your favorite apps and services for enhanced productivity workflows through built-in integrations or MCP
connects our AI Assistant to all your business applications, letting you accomplish complex workflows without ever leaving your inbox.
